subject: [PATCH v4 07/19] selftests/mm: move is_backed_by_folio() into vm_util

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch moves the is_backed_by_folio() function from split_huge_page_test.c to vm_util.c, making it available for use in other tests. The function checks if an address range is backed by a folio of a given order, which is useful for testing large folios and mTHP collapse coverage. No functional changes are made, only the location of the function is updated.
